summary: Galera Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting the mandatory conversion of its remaining 42,839.11 Series B Non-Voting Convertible Preferred shares into 42,839,103 common shares at no stated price or premium. The conversion extinguished all Series B Preferred Stock, was executed per the existing Certificate of Designation, and fractional shares were cashed out. There is no consideration, recommendation, or advisor; this is a routine capital-structure cleanup removing preferred overhang. No special situation catalyst exists — it is a non-event for strategy or deal flow.
